question: Explain how prime factorisation gives the HCF and LCM.
answer: For HCF, take the minimum occurrence of each prime common to all numbers. For LCM, take the maximum occurrence of every prime appearing in the numbers.
explanation: This is the efficient procedure developed after listing factors/multiples.
